decision.claim_boundary: A pass shows a loaded module's per-entity 4-way value, recovered from its bank feature and injected as an operand-MARGINALIZED delta, drives the base to compose T[m][q] in the forward pass from the recovered m + the VISIBLE operand q (swept) + the published table -- tracking T[m][q] as q varies with the injected signal held fixed. A deterministic visible-record lookup is structurally barred from this (G0). It does not establish frozen no-refit transfer (5.72b), K>4, or alpha-scale generalization.
